_note: Hand-written stand-in for LLM output (LLM_MODE=replay). It exercises the checks, repair loop and refusals offline. It does NOT measure a model; use LLM_MODE=anthropic or gemini for that. Three entries are deliberately wrong on the first attempt: an unknown property, a class that is never stored, and a syntax error. One write request is answered with a DELETE to test the read-only guard.
